answer: Sybil resistance arises because identities are bonded to collateral escrows: when k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting states, the protocol aggregates correlated faults and applies a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), rather than treating them independently. Detection also imposes an exponential capital-loss multiplier, draining the attacker’s vault; thus a grove of aliases cannot cheaply amplify influence, even with copper-level seed capital.
